summary: NULL means a value is missing or unknown. It is not 0 and not empty text, and it needs IS NULL and IS NOT NULL to test.
notes: Any comparison with NULL, even NULL = NULL, is unknown, so WHERE gpa = NULL matches no rows.
COALESCE(grade, 'Not graded') returns the first value that is not NULL.
A NULL grade is neither under 80 nor 80 and over, so it is left out of both results.
pitfall: Writing WHERE gpa = NULL or WHERE gpa != NULL runs without an error but returns nothing. Use IS NULL or IS NOT NULL.
